attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Iowa corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Iowa Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.ia_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts); result.ia_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ia_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus - filing required (no transaction count as of 7/1/2023)

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.ia_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.ia_tax_liability xdef "Iowa filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Iowa state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. IA requires addback of state taxes deducted federally and allows subtraction of federal interest income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Iowa Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ia_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ia_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Iowa state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.ia_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ia_state_subtractions xdef "Iowa adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Iowa corporate income tax. Applies Iowa graduated rates (5.5% on first $100K, 7.1% over $100K) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Iowa Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ia_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ia_tax_bracket_1 xdef 0.0 result.ia_tax_bracket_2 xdef 0.0 result.ia_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ia_apportioned_income is greater than 0
Income exceeds $100,000 bracket threshold; result.ia_taxable_income is greater than result.ia_tax_bracket_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Iowa tax with graduated rates - income over $100K; Apply graduated rates: 5.5% on first $100K, 7.1% on excess
Calculate Iowa tax - income $100K or less (only 5.5% rate); Apply only 5.5% rate for income under $100K
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.ia_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ia_tax_liability xdef result.ia_estimated_payments result.ia_refund_or_owed xdef "Iowa tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.ia_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ia_tax_liability xdef result.ia_estimated_payments result.ia_refund_or_owed xdef "Iowa tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
